name: A Token of Good Faith
summary: Danitha sends you to carry Rudolph Gelhardt’s head to Sylvanas Windrunner in the Undercity. The delivery is meant to show the Forsaken that your people are devoted to their prosperity.

sections.title: A Show of Loyalty
sections.body: Danitha says Sylvanas distrusts your people and openly disparages them. She asks you to bring Rudolph Gelhardt’s head as proof that you tend to your own house and stand with the Forsaken.

sections.title: The Dark Lady’s Answer
sections.body: Sylvanas doubts Danitha’s order can stop more of its members from turning the Light against their own people. She warns that she may no longer tolerate the order if it stops serving the Forsaken’s interests. The order will be watched.

faq.q: Who asks me to bring Rudolph Gelhardt’s head to Sylvanas?
faq.answer: Danitha asks you to carry Rudolph Gelhardt’s head to Sylvanas Windrunner in the Undercity.

faq.q: Why does Danitha want me to bring the head to Sylvanas?
faq.answer: Danitha wants the delivery to show Sylvanas that your people tend to their own house and are devoted to the prosperity of the Forsaken.

faq.q: Why does Sylvanas mistrust Danitha’s people?
faq.answer: Danitha says Sylvanas greatly mistrusts your people and nearly openly disparages them.

faq.q: Where do I take Rudolph Gelhardt’s head?
faq.answer: You are asked to bring Rudolph Gelhardt’s head to Sylvanas Windrunner in the Undercity.
